synopsis: Chapter 3 and the glossary agree that Model WHS Regulations regulation 215 requires powered mobile plant collision risks involving pedestrians and other mobile plant to be controlled so far as reasonably practicable [f2254, f15531]. A warning device is required where collision is possible [f2255, f15531]. The corpus identifies no prescribed automatic braking, test speed or distance, and reports no prescribed testing requirements, leaving these provisions without numerical validation criteria [f2257, f2784, f15532]. The regulations are model law and are in force where adopted by states and territories [f2781]. Chapter 3 identifies the June 2023 edition of “Managing the risks of plant in the workplace” as the official explanatory material for the powered mobile plant requirements [f2258, f2782].
